outcome: price per sqm relative to the median of the same town, flat type and quarter

drivers.label: Living on a high floor
drivers.why: Same block and flat type, so location, block age and estate are identical.

drivers.label: Having more lease left
drivers.why: Same town, flat type and 10 sqm size band. Newer blocks also differ in design and location within the town, so this mixes lease with block age.

drivers.label: Being within 500 m of a station
drivers.why: Same town, flat type, size band and lease band. Stations sit next to town centres, so this also picks up being close to malls and hawker centres.

drivers.contrast: 500 m-1 km vs >1 km from MRT/LRT
drivers.label: Being 500 m - 1 km from a station
drivers.why: As above, for the middle distance band.

caveat: Associations in historical sales, not causal effects.
